scope: Assess the justification for existing A03 pre-observation criteria; no source, threshold, state, Skill or hardware changes. No online claims or new numeric admission thresholds.

bottom_line.exact_30s_all_TCP_current_in_band_and_10: Not demonstrated to be a universal or scientifically necessary physical safety boundary for this repair trajectory. They are frozen local engineering criteria for a reproducible, relatively quiet starting state.
bottom_line.possibly_overly_strict: Yes, especially the requirement that every sparse TCP current sample across 30 s lies within +/-20%; its rejection probability depends on noise, sampling, correlation and duration. It can reject a functioning feedback state with finite stationary noise. This does not establish that all current-gate failures are harmless.
bottom_line.current_necessity: A known, bounded and recoverable starting state remains necessary. Image impairment supplies a repair rationale, not a reason to ignore unresolved control instability.
bottom_line.existing_A03: Retain and evaluate the currently frozen rules exactly. This draft does not change a rejection to acceptance or authorize a second attempt.
bottom_line.new_gate_possible: A separate prospective engineering protocol can be justified by action-specific evidence and explicitly accepted uncertainty. Current evidence alone does not determine a new safe numeric limit.

code_verified_semantics.pre: Run.observe(pre=True) calls guard(entry=True) on every observation throughout 30 s, hence every TCP current sample must be within [-120,-80] pA; last10 s Z is then fit for slope and detrended RMS. Final >=5 s current-band condition is redundant during successful pre-observation.
code_verified_semantics.post_difference: Post-observation does not apply the narrow current band at every sample; it uses the original sampled broad gate, persistent-fault check and final band/trend conditions. Pre and post are not identical statistics.
code_verified_semantics.window: trend selects the bracket including a sample at or before the last10 s cutoff, requires >=20 observations and gaps <=1 s. These are sequential TCP observations, not simultaneous 2 kHz data.
code_verified_semantics.trajectory_from_local_frozen_plan: 50 ms Z averaging/switch-off delay; -0.9 nm over 0.2 s at initial -1 V because ChangeBias=False; lifting bias +2 V and 0.1 s settle; +5 nm from bottom over 1 s; restore bias, 0.1 s end wait and initial feedback. Nominal +4.1 nm relative starting level before feedback, not final feedback height or contact depth.
code_verified_semantics.separate_constraints: Full configuration/On2/idle/SafeOff/XY, software Z endpoint and full-trajectory margins, logger coverage, known ACK/end, one-shot budget and no replay remain distinct from narrow observation-noise tolerances.

what_205_data_do_and_do_not_establish.native_late30: I -111.887 +/-28.393 pA (std); Z slope -0.356 pm/s, detrended RMS15.402 pm. Native late10 RMS14.879 pm. Post302.14 s has one isolated >=400 pA point and no >=1nA or exact software-floor match; only the immediate post-scan adjacent-1s median shift exceeded the descriptive100pm query.
what_205_data_do_and_do_not_establish.different_observable: Native late30 RMS15.4pm cannot be substituted into the code last10s sparse TCP metric. Windows, sampling and possible averaging/filtering differ. A native/TCP bandwidth and time-window mapping has not been demonstrated here.
what_205_data_do_and_do_not_establish.not_safe_because_small_ratio: 15.4pm is arithmetically about1.7% of900pm, but commanded approach is not known clearance. Starting gap, surface response, feedback-off reference, atom rearrangement and absolute calibration are unknown; neither this ratio nor later+5nm withdrawal proves a safe approach.
what_205_data_do_and_do_not_establish.absence_of_large_jump: No late adjacent1s-median jump >=100pm in this finite interval lowers evidence for that specific persistent working-point behavior. It does not exclude shorter events, smaller switching, oscillation, changing electronic response, or a later jump. The100pm query is not a new acceptance limit.
what_205_data_do_and_do_not_establish.averaging: A 50ms Z average can reduce some fast components, depending on spectrum/correlation, but it does not guarantee a stable atomic configuration or suppress telegraph/slow drift. Need actual aligned measurements; cannot divide RMS by sqrt(number of samples) without independence evidence.
what_205_data_do_and_do_not_establish.gate_vs_effect: A low noise gate does not prove the -900pm trajectory safe, and passing it does not predict repair. Conversely an image failure does not establish that widening the gate is safe.

legitimate_prospective_reassessment: Define the gate purpose explicitly: known operational control, repeatable starting level and adequate remaining trajectory margin, not clean image or chemical cleanliness.

Use same-point, same setpoint/bias/gain stationary native and TCP windows, with actual time alignment and measured sampling/filtering. Preserve raw events while separately characterizing mean error, trend, fluctuation distribution, correlation, transitions and recovery.
Compare stationary-noise intervals with already observed true working-point jumps and unresolved failures. A rule should discriminate those modes rather than merely include the latest failing value.

For Z, distinguish smooth drift, bounded fluctuations and abrupt state changes; document uncertainty in the starting Z reference over the real averaging/switch-off interval and relative to actuator margins. This does not independently calibrate tip-sample gap.

Separate an observation criterion from a hard state/transport constraint. If any noise statistic is revised, specify its data stream, window, finite wait, acceptance interpretation, and unchanged unknown-ACK/limits/control/recording branches.

Freeze a new version, rationale and tests before a later attempt; preserve the original failed preflight and all action counts. Keep post-action recovery and full matched image/independent confirmation requirements explicit rather than silently loosening them along with entry.
insufficient_justifications: It failed the existing rule, therefore choose a threshold just above the observed result.
The commanded displacement is much larger than the noise, or retract follows approach, therefore contact or overload cannot occur.
Mean current is near setpoint, therefore Z/tip state is stable.
No exact current floor or no>=100pm median jump means all relevant instability is absent.
Images require repair or user authorized conditioning, therefore existing instrumentation constraints no longer apply.
Previously successful low-current or different-location actions calibrate this state without comparable provenance.
Use pixel/TCP averages to erase faster excursions or treat an observation window as an allowed overload duration.
remaining_unknowns: Absolute current tip-sample clearance and local approach response.
Current effective high-frequency and low-frequency transfer/averaging between native and TCP Z.
Whether present fluctuations are stationary measurement/control noise or changing junction configurations.
A calibrated relationship between an entry RMS tolerance and outcome of this mechanical trajectory.

_portable_export.path_basis: Rewritten included paths resolve relative to this JSON; local-archive IDs resolve in omitted-evidence.json. Embedded scientific source hashes still refer to the original local bytes, not transformed exports.
